selection_method: Product admin/configuration/new-feature guides selected primary mechanisms. Community/KB pages are scenario context only. Candidate topics compared to the rolling 30-day inventory and known failed-draft candidates; semantically equivalent subjects rejected.

topics.lesson_subject: SNAT source-port preservation under collision: port-preserve defaults, ephemeral-port floor, and explicit mapping
topics.scenario_date: 2026-10-09 (search result says published 3 weeks ago; exact date needs page-level confirmation)
topics.mechanism: SNAT source port preservation: preserve original source port only when eligible and available; fallback allocation and explicit mapping for low source ports
topics.workflow: session creation -> central SNAT/policy NAT -> port-preserve eligibility/collision -> translated tuple -> reverse tuple in session table
topics.failure_class: unexpected source-port translation breaks upstream pinholes or IKE NAT expectations
topics.evidence: diagnose sys session list origin/reply tuples and translated source port; compare after clearing old session
topics.remediation: check FortiOS version, port-preserve setting, 5117-65533 eligibility, existing tuple collisions; use explicit port mapping only when suitable
topics.question: Which session-table evidence distinguishes port-preserve eligibility from a collision-driven fallback?
topics.diagram: client original tuple -> FortiGate SNAT decision -> public tuple -> reply reverse mapping; branch for low port/collision

topics.lesson_subject: ADOM revision diff and restore: snapshot scope, auto-deletion locks, and re-install sequencing
topics.mechanism: ADOM snapshot captures policy packages, objects, and VPN console settings; restore is distinct from managed-device config revision revert
topics.workflow: create named ADOM revision -> lock against auto-delete if needed -> compare diff -> restore database snapshot -> import device config -> reinstall package
topics.failure_class: restored ADOM database differs from device or package state after restore
topics.evidence: ADOM revision diff and revision metadata; device package status and install preview after restore
topics.remediation: make a pre-change revision, lock critical baseline, restore correct ADOM snapshot, import managed device configuration, re-install package
topics.question: After restoring an ADOM revision, which step realigns the package with the managed device?
topics.diagram: ADOM snapshot -> revision diff/restore -> ADOM DB -> device import -> package install

topics.lesson_subject: Log Fetching between analyzers: fetch approval, ADOM synchronization, transfer completion, and database rebuild
topics.mechanism: pull archived logs from a server FortiAnalyzer to a client for historical analysis; transfer completion is separate from index/database rebuild completion
topics.workflow: fetch profile -> request -> sync device/ADOM mapping -> server approves -> transfer -> index fetched logs -> rebuild ADOM/database -> reports usable
topics.failure_class: fetch shows Done but logs are not yet queryable because indexing/rebuild remains incomplete or device/ADOM mapping is stale
topics.evidence: System Settings > Advanced > Log Fetch > Sessions; rebuild progress; query a known device/time range after indexing
topics.remediation: confirm same firmware, request approval, sync devices/ADOMs after changes, monitor transfer and rebuild, run ADOM rebuild if indexing option disabled
topics.question: What does a completed transfer fail to prove about historical log queryability?
topics.diagram: client profile/request <-> server approval -> archive transfer -> client index/rebuild -> query/report

topics.lesson_subject: LLDP-MED network policy for voice endpoints: VLAN advertisement, DSCP/priority, and port prerequisites
topics.mechanism: LLDP-MED network-policy TLVs advertise voice VLAN and QoS to phones; the port still needs allowed VLAN and profile/LLDP TX-RX
topics.workflow: phone sends LLDP -> switch advertises network policy -> phone tags voice traffic -> VLAN trunk carries it -> DHCP reaches voice subnet
topics.failure_class: phone associates but receives native/data VLAN address or no voice DHCP lease
topics.evidence: show switch lldp profile, port LLDP status, VLAN membership, packet capture for LLDP-MED TLV, DHCP scope logs
topics.remediation: enable network-policy TLV and assign VLAN interface, apply profile to correct port, allow voice VLAN, enable LLDP tx/rx, verify DHCP relay/server
topics.question: Which missing dependency explains a phone receiving the data VLAN despite a configured LLDP-MED profile?
topics.diagram: FortiSwitch port + data PC/phone -> LLDP-MED TLV -> voice VLAN tag -> DHCP path

topics.lesson_subject: Wireless client load balancing: AP handoff versus frequency handoff and RSSI-driven retries
topics.scenario_date: 2024 (older scenario; exact date is on the page)
topics.mechanism: controller chooses association response/handoff using station count and 5 GHz RSSI; AP handoff selects weakest client to move; roaming clients excluded
topics.workflow: client association request -> controller checks client/band/RSSI and AP load -> accept, defer/retry, or steer to another AP/band
topics.failure_class: sticky client, repeated association retries, or poor experience caused by aggressive handoff thresholds/overlapping coverage
topics.evidence: WTP profile handoff-sta-thresh, handoff-rssi, frequency-handoff/ap-handoff; client RSSI per band and association events
topics.remediation: tune threshold against actual cell design, ensure neighbor AP can hear client at target RSSI, avoid applying aggressive settings to IoT SSIDs, test roaming clients separately
topics.question: Why can enabling frequency handoff increase retries for a dual-band client with weak 5 GHz RSSI?
topics.diagram: controller with AP1/AP2, client 2.4/5 GHz RSSI decision, AP load branch

topics.lesson_subject: Registered-host Network Access Policy first-match evaluation and catch-all ordering
topics.mechanism: policy joins a User/Host Profile to a Network Access Configuration; ranked top-down first match wins for registered hosts; host/location is reevaluated as evidence changes
topics.workflow: host record/user/location evidence -> ordered profile match -> VLAN/CLI/VPN group treatment -> periodic re-evaluation after polling or agent contact
topics.failure_class: unexpected VLAN/treatment because a broad earlier profile matches or the host is not eligible/registered
topics.evidence: Host View online/registered state, port in Role-Based Access group, Policy Simulator, Policy Details, policy rank
topics.remediation: move specific policies above broad ones, keep catch-all last, verify registered-host eligibility and location/user criteria, re-evaluate after polls
topics.question: Why is a correctly configured specific policy ignored when a broad profile sits above it?
topics.diagram: host/user/location facts -> ordered policy list -> first matching treatment -> periodic reevaluation

topics.lesson_subject: Upgrade migration from Legacy RADIUS Proxy to Virtual Proxy Server in FortiNAC-F 7.4+
topics.mechanism: 7.4+ uses Virtual Servers (Local/Proxy); legacy proxy view persists only for upgraded pre-7.4 configs, and new virtual proxy objects may be auto-created
topics.workflow: upgrade -> inspect Virtual Servers and Legacy Proxy -> validate proxy server/auth-accounting ports -> update device/VDOM/SSID model configuration -> validate -> disable legacy mode
topics.failure_class: RADIUS requests stop or are misrouted after upgrade because device configuration still references legacy proxy or required allowaccess/attribute group is wrong
topics.evidence: Network > RADIUS tabs, virtual server type, model configuration RADIUS mode, port1 allowaccess, RADIUS activity/logs
topics.remediation: validate auto-created virtual proxy, switch each device/VDOM/SSID to it, review default RFC_Vlan attribute group, enable appropriate radius/radius-acct or radius-local, then disable legacy configuration only after tests
topics.question: What must be changed on devices after validating the newly created virtual proxy server?
topics.diagram: upgrade boundary -> legacy proxy config -> virtual server objects -> per-device/SSID binding -> auth/accounting

topics.lesson_subject: RADIUS policy selection: request-attribute criteria, top-down precedence, and EAP termination versus proxy
topics.mechanism: client-bound RADIUS policies match request attributes top-down; policy selects auth type/identity source/reply attributes; EAP options apply to locally terminated EAP, not proxied EAP
topics.workflow: RADIUS Access-Request -> client/policy match -> identity source and auth method -> local EAP or proxy -> Access-Accept/Reject with configured reply attrs
topics.failure_class: wrong identity source/group or unexpected reject because a request attribute fails the top-ranked policy criteria
topics.evidence: RADIUS debug Access-Request attributes, matched policy, identity source result, local/proxy virtual server and response attributes
topics.remediation: verify NAS-IP/NAS-Identifier and other request attrs, order specific policies before broad ones, distinguish local EAP termination from proxy, test each tunnel/client
topics.question: Why does a policy with missing NAS-IP criterion fail to match even when the user credentials are valid?
topics.diagram: NAS request attributes -> ordered RADIUS policies -> identity source/auth method -> local/proxy -> reply

topics.lesson_subject: FortiPAM approval revocation as a live session-control action
topics.scenario_date: 2025-05 (search result says published 1.7 years ago; older context)
topics.mechanism: approval request has tier/approver state; in 1.9+ Revoke Approval can withdraw an approved request even after launch and terminates the active secret session
topics.workflow: request secret access -> approver tier(s) -> time-bounded authorization -> active launcher session -> revoke approval -> session termination and request reset
topics.failure_class: operator assumes revoke only affects future launches or sees revoke unavailable under older single-approver tier semantics
topics.evidence: Approval List status, tier/approver configuration, My Requests state, Monitoring > Active Sessions, session termination event
topics.remediation: confirm release supports Revoke Approval, configure tier/approver expectations, revoke from approval record, verify active session termination and request reset
topics.question: What is the operational effect of revoking an already approved request in FortiPAM 1.9+?
topics.diagram: request -> tier approvals -> authorized session -> revoke -> session termination + request reset

topics.lesson_subject: Rule execution modes: streaming versus scheduled and scheduled-via-SQL evidence boundaries
topics.mechanism: rule subpatterns filter events, group-by attributes define incident identity, aggregate conditions set thresholds; scheduled/SQL modes trade time-window scale for trigger-event and testing limitations
topics.workflow: ingest/normalize event -> subpattern filters -> group by and aggregation within window -> trigger incident -> clear condition and scheduled run boundaries
topics.failure_class: rule fires differently or lacks trigger events because rule mode, backend, time window, group-by or clear condition differs
topics.evidence: rule type/mode, query window/timezone, group-by fields, aggregate threshold, trigger events and incident cap/status
topics.remediation: choose streaming for low-latency/testable behavior; scheduled for larger windows/complex analytics; validate ClickHouse-only SQL limitations and clear conditions
topics.question: Which mode can run complex SQL rules on ClickHouse but may omit trigger events from incidents?
topics.diagram: event stream -> rule mode selector -> filters/subpatterns -> group-by/aggregate -> incident evidence

topics.lesson_subject: Security PoP migration lifecycle: staged target, 30-day cutover, and endpoint/PAC dependencies
topics.mechanism: migration adds target PoP disabled; target can be activated before source decommission; unattended migration auto-enables target and decommissions source after 30 days
topics.workflow: select source/target -> provision target disabled -> enable/validate -> endpoint and PAC reference review -> source decommission after transition window
topics.failure_class: endpoint still references regional PoP IP or PAC fetch URL after migration, causing proxy connectivity failure despite new PoP healthy
topics.evidence: Infrastructure PoP state, edge config FQDN versus direct IP, PAC file fetch address and regional references, endpoint connectivity
topics.remediation: plan timing, enable/validate target, update direct-IP edges and regional PAC references, preserve global FQDN paths, verify before 30-day automatic transition
topics.question: Which deployment type still requires endpoint reconfiguration when its PAC file uses a regional PoP address?
topics.diagram: source PoP -> target provisioned disabled -> activation/validation -> endpoint/PAC references -> source decommission

topics.lesson_subject: Dynamic SDN connector addresses in SD-WAN rules: cloud inventory refresh to path-selection match
topics.mechanism: external SDN connector imports cloud resource addresses into a dynamic Fabric Connector Address; SD-WAN service rules match the refreshed address set
topics.workflow: connector API poll -> dynamic address object filter -> refreshed IP set -> SD-WAN rule destination match -> strategy selects healthy member
topics.failure_class: cloud workloads stop matching intended path rule because connector credentials, filters, polling or address-object linkage is stale
topics.evidence: diagnose sys sdn status, connector update logs, dynamic address resolved IP list, diagnose sys sdwan service destination address set
topics.remediation: verify connector connectivity and polling, filter/tag values, address object connector association and rule reference; use azd debug to observe IP refresh
topics.question: Which evidence distinguishes a healthy SDN connector from a dynamic address object actually used by an SD-WAN rule?
topics.diagram: cloud inventory -> SDN connector -> dynamic address object -> SD-WAN rule -> selected member
